body.statement: The macro target is uniformly identified over \(\mathfrak M(H,d)\) if and only if both conditions hold: it is identified within every \(G\in\mathfrak R(H)\), and for every \(G_1,G_2\in\mathfrak R(H)\) the corresponding local target maps agree at every \(p\in\Omega_{G_1}\cap\Omega_{G_2}\). When the conditions hold, the map \(f(p)=\phi_G(p)\) for any \(G\) with \(p\in\Omega_G\) is well defined on \(\Omega_H\).
body.justification: This preliminary gluing fact isolates the semantic overlap obligation without claiming to solve its constructive representation problem.
body.gap: TehSadeghiSoo2025RobustID gives a sufficient shared-expression criterion for candidate SA-MPDAGs; it does not characterize agreement only on common observable-law images of hidden-variable refinements.
body.consumer: It supplies the correctness specification against which the ranked overlap saturation is judged.
